shared_knowledge.title: 色彩构成：70-20-10 色板比例黄金法则
shared_knowledge.body: 画面色彩严格遵循 70% 主导底色（稳住大体量与环境基调）、20% 辅助次色（区分结构层级与透气过渡）、10% 高对比点缀色（仅用于视觉中心与核心识别锚点）；严禁未经授权的高饱和荧光/霓虹杂色乱入破坏色调统一。

banned_habits: 白底不可接受，要和L1一样透明/黑空底；档差要一眼可辨且体量递增；禁止换物种；零件必须累计
keep_phrases: 确认作为风格正向锚点：软立体圆角玩具感微型花园；巨型花草尺度差；花瓣屋顶与暖陶木结构；柔漫左上日光；饱和友好pastel；哑光缎面；Q版小动物角色
确认作为风格正向锚点：妖精花园样张可复用日晒草绿#A1B041与叶面绿#658C55铺满草地和巨叶
确认作为货柜正向锚点：合成宣传图里的道具是圆润厚实的糖釉卡通3D。
确认作为渲染正向锚点：加载宣传图证明同一套圆润厚实、无硬描边、暖色辉光加冷色补光。釉面高光接近#FEFDFB。
banned_habits_raw_tail: 禁止偏离样张画风：过度霓虹、脏暗阴影、油腻高光、写实皮肤毛孔、扁平UI描边

reasonableness.draft_prompt: 4x2 watering merge sheet black cards cup spout pump backpack hose cart
reasonableness.revised_prompt:
Portrait 9:16 merge overview sheet, strict 4 rows by 2 columns. Eight equal rounded soft-white cards on PURE BLACK opaque isolation (#000000). chain_mode=same_object. base_body=garden watering tool family. One single centered complete SKU per cell, not a scene, no people, no environment props. Gossip Harbor glossy cartoon 3D teal celadon, soft light, no hard outlines, no level numbers, no text, no faces.

Strict subject-box heights: L1=0.40 L2=0.48 L3=0.56 L4=0.64 L5=0.72 L6=0.80 L7=0.86 L8=0.96 of card height. L7 hose-reel occupied height must be clearly taller than or at least equal to L6 backpack; L8 must be taller than both L6 and L7 and widest.

Identity replacement ladder:
1 open water cup only
2 short pointed spout can NO rose
3 long open-tube spout can NO rose
4 first rose/shower disc can
5 hand pump mister bottle taller
6 backpack spray tank with straps
7 hose reel disk ONLY no nozzle no wand
8 ONE-PIECE irrigation cart: rectangular tank body IS the vehicle chassis, fixed horizontal spray boom arm welded to tank, four wheels under tank; FORBID a watering-can silhouette welded onto a wheel frame; FORBID separate can stuck on cart.

Keep teal family. Soft oval contact shadow. Margin inside cards; no clipping.
